faq.subtitle: Short answers about call purpose, consent, and human handoff.
faq.a1: aiCALL answers inbound calls and calls your existing customers to confirm bookings, deliveries, visits, payments, or reminders. It uses approved information and writes every result to the dashboard.
faq.a2: aiCALL fits clinics, salons, service centers, delivery teams, and any company that needs many short customer confirmations.
faq.q3: Can aiCALL use a bought or scraped number list?
faq.a3: No. aiNOW does not call a bought or scraped list. Georgian law requires consent for direct marketing regardless of where the data came from. Under aiNOW's launch policy, every marketing campaign also needs a written or electronic consent record.
faq.a4: A human joins when the customer asks a complex question, refuses, requests a person, or the approved script is no longer enough.
faq.q5: What result does the business get?
faq.a5: The business gets a list of confirmed, postponed, unanswered, and human-handoff calls. The team stops listening to every call by hand.
faq.q6: Can the call move to a real employee?
faq.a6: Yes. You choose the handoff number and the situations that require a person. The employee receives the customer while the context is still clear.
faq.a7: The functional plan determines aiCALL capabilities. Inbound calls use a separate GEL minute bundle at an indicative 0.54 GEL per conversation minute. Outbound conversation time currently costs 1.40 GEL per minute after the customer answers. aiNOW confirms the final configuration in writing.
faq.q8: What is needed before a test starts?
faq.a8: aiNOW needs the approved list, short script, consent basis and handoff number. The start date is agreed only after those checks are complete.
faq.q9: What if the customer does not answer?
faq.a9: The agreed retry rule applies. After the final attempt, the outcome becomes no answer and your employee decides whether another follow-up is appropriate.
faq.q10: Can aiCALL use our spreadsheet or booking system?
faq.a10: Excel and Google Sheets can provide the call list. aiNOW reviews an existing booking system before confirming any connection to it.
faq.q11: Can the same flow use Russian or English?
faq.a11: The flow can be configured for Georgian, Russian and English. Your team approves each language's script and sample separately before calls begin.
faq.q12: What answer rate should we expect?
faq.a12: aiNOW does not publish a borrowed answer rate as your result. The outcome board shows what will be measured on your approved campaign without presenting this demo as customer data.
faq.q13: Can it remind customers about a payment?
faq.a13: A reminder tied to an existing agreement can be reviewed. A dispute, new offer or payment question goes to a person. aiCALL does not collect card details by phone.
faq.q14: What is the difference between aiCALL, aiSTAFF and aiOFFICE?
faq.a14: aiCALL handles approved phone calls. aiSTAFF handles customer messages. aiOFFICE supports internal documents and approvals. aiNOW helps you choose the product that matches the work.

consent.heading: Check the list before any campaign starts.
consent.subtitle: Answer all three questions yourself. aiCALL never fills them in for you.
consent.q1yes: Yes, they booked, ordered or signed with us
consent.q1no: No, the list was bought, shared or collected elsewhere
consent.q2: Is the call only about their existing relationship with you?
consent.q2yes: Yes, an appointment, order or current agreement
consent.q2no: No, we want to offer something new
consent.q3: Under aiNOW's launch policy, can you show a consent record for marketing calls?
consent.q3yes: Yes, a written or electronic record is available
consent.q3no: No, or the consent record is uncertain
consent.greenBody: These are your own customers and the call concerns an existing appointment, order or agreement. aiNOW can prepare an operational script after the details are checked.
consent.amberBody: One answer changes the call category. Do not start yet. aiNOW separates operational calls from marketing. Under aiNOW's launch policy, every marketing launch needs a written or electronic consent record.
consent.redBody: The list is not yours and no marketing-consent record is available. Under aiNOW's launch policy, calls will not start from this list.
consent.law: Under Article 12, direct marketing needs consent regardless of how the data were obtained or whether they are publicly accessible. Written consent is required when the data go beyond name, surname, address, phone number and email. A withdrawal request must be honoured within seven working days.
consent.notice: This check is practical guidance, not legal advice. If the facts are unclear, aiNOW pauses the campaign and asks for a legal review.
consent.demoLabel: Illustrative preview — no answer is selected
consent.demoStep0: The preview points to each check without choosing an answer.
consent.demoStep1: First, confirm whose customers are in the list.
consent.demoStep2: Then, separate an operational call from a new offer.
consent.demoStep3: For marketing, check the consent record before launch.
consent.outcome: Unsafe or unclear lists stop before a call starts.

board.heading: See the outcome of every call.

barge.heading: The customer can stop the script.
barge.subtitle: Watch the agent stop, acknowledge the interruption, offer a next step and mark the outcome. Press Interrupt to try it yourself.
barge.recovery: Understood. When should a person call you back?
barge.note: The agent does not argue or guess. A changed request becomes a clear task for your employee.

heroStory.input: Call everyone booked for tomorrow and tell them about the new entrance. If somebody calls us, answer and book an open time.
heroStory.bridge: Two tasks: call the approved list and answer incoming calls. iAI sends both to aiCALL.
heroStory.productAction: One workflow handles calls in both directions.
heroStory.detailOne: Outbound: Nino heard the update and confirmed her visit
heroStory.detailTwo: Inbound: Giorgi called, got an answer, and booked an open time
heroStory.businessValue: Both call outcomes are saved. The team does not need to call and update the schedule by hand.
